diagnosis: Childhood myelodysplastic neoplasm with increased blasts
legend: Relative erythroid hyperplasia with synchronized left-shifted maturation in hypoplastic bone marrow with a diffuse pattern. Granulopoiesis shows left-shifted maturation with increased blasts, and there is an increase of small megakaryocytes with micromegakaryocytes and very few mature megakaryocytes.

diagnosis: Childhood myelodysplastic neoplasm with increased blasts
legend: CD34-positive blasts are increased, without clustering.
